# lc-base-template

> Starter template for building accessible, interactive language-course exercise
> engines with React, TypeScript and Vite. Each engine is a self-contained,
> keyboard-operable, WCAG-conscious component driven by validated JSON content.

## Pages

A build emits a static course: a landing page plus one page per Learning Object.

- [Home](/index.html): the course landing page — hero copy plus one card per
  Learning Object, linking to that LO's page.
- `/<slug>.html`: one page per LO folder in `lo-config/`, named after the folder
  with its `lo-NN-` ordinal dropped (`lo-00-example` → `/example.html`). Each
  page's body is prerendered, so it reads and navigates without JavaScript, and
  hydrates into the interactive app when JavaScript runs.

Two debug pages exist and are **not part of a deployed course**. The exercise
showcase (`/exercise-showcase.html`) is a gallery of every engine driven by
fixtures; the debug sandbox (`/debug-sandbox.html`) is a theme-token, typography
and icon reference for the designer. Both are **opt-in per build** behind one fail-closed flag (`DEBUG=1 bun run build`,
or the older name `SHOWCASE=1`), so a deployed course contains neither unless
that flag was set. They are listed here so their absence is not mistaken for a
broken link; do not treat either as a page of the course.

## Engines

Fifteen engines ship. Each lives under `src/exercises/<engine>/` with a pure
grader plus a thin React view, and is registered in
`src/exercises/lazyRegistry.ts`.

- Choice: select, inline-choice, radio-quiz
- Typing: inline-gap, typed-transform, dictation, text entry within engines
- Matching: line-match, memory-match, word-spot
- Ordering: word-order, phrase-reorder, drag-fill-gaps
- Study and reading: flashcards, reading, conjugation

## Notes

- UI chrome strings resolve through `src/config/ui-strings.ts` (English by default);
  authored content carries the target language via `lang` attributes.
- Design tokens and theme colours live in `src/styles/`.
- This file describes the **built site**. Repository-level house rules for AI
  agents editing the source live in `AGENTS.md`, which is not shipped.
